90|# In order to maintain compatibility with older platforms which may not have a
91|# recent version of CMake (i.e. are running CMake <3.3), we cannot simply use
92|# the `add_compile_options` with a generator expression.  This uses the
93|# `target_compile_options` with `PRIVATE` to add the flags only to the targets
94|# so that CMark may be used in projects with non-C languages.
95|function(cmark_add_compile_options target)
96|  if(MSVC)
97|    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
98|  else()
99|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
100|            -Wall -Wextra -pedantic
101|            $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-Wstrict-prototypes>)
102|  endif()
103|  if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL Profile)
104|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pg)
105|  endif()
106|  if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL Ubsan)
107|    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=undefined)
108|  endif()
109|  if(CMARK_LIB_FUZZER)
110|    if(target MATCHES fuzz)
111|      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
112|      target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
113|    else()
114|      target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
115|      target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
116|    endif()
117|  endif()
118|endfunction()

132|

134|# normally need to be generated.
135|$(SRCDIR)/scanners.c: $(SRCDIR)/scanners.re
136|	@case "$$(re2c -v)" in \
137|	    *\ 0.13.*|*\ 0.14|*\ 0.14.1) \
138|		echo "re2c >= 0.14.2 is required"; \
139|		false; \

153| > $(SPEC)

155|test: $(SPEC) cmake_build
156|	ctest --test-dir $(BUILDDIR) --output-on-failure || (cat $(BUILDDIR)/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log && exit 1)

159|	python3 test/spec_tests.py --spec $< --dump-tests | python3 -c 'import json; import sys; tests = json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print("\n".join([test["markdown"] for test in tests]))' > $@
160|
161|leakcheck: $(ALLTESTS)
162|	for format in html man xml latex commonmark; do \
163|	  for opts in "" "--smart"; do \
164|	     echo "cmark -t $$format $$opts" ; \
165|	     valgrind -q --leak-check=full --dsymutil=yes --error-exitcode=1 $(PROG) -t $$format $$opts $(ALLTESTS) >/dev/null || exit 1;\
166|          done; \
167|	done;
168|
169|fuzztest:
170|	{ for i in `seq 1 10`; do \
171|	  cat /dev/urandom | head -c $(FUZZCHARS) | iconv -f latin1 -t utf-8 | tee fuzz-$$i.txt | \
172|		/usr/bin/env time -p $(PROG) >/dev/null && rm fuzz-$$i.txt ; \
173|	done } 2>&1 | grep 'user\|abnormally'
174|
175|progit:
176|	git clone https://github.com/progit/progit.git
177|
178|$(BENCHFILE): progit
179|	echo "" > $@
180|	for lang in ar az be ca cs de en eo es es-ni fa fi fr hi hu id it ja ko mk nl no-nb pl pt-br ro ru sr th tr uk vi zh zh-tw; do \
181|	cat progit/$$lang/*/*.markdown >> $@; \
182|	done

184|# for more accurate results, run with
185|# sudo renice -10 $$; make bench
186|bench: $(BENCHFILE)
187|	{ for x in `seq 1 $(NUMRUNS)` ; do \
188|		/usr/bin/env time -p $(PROG) </dev/null >/dev/null ; \
189|		/usr/bin/env time -p $(PROG) $< >/dev/null ; \
190|		done \
191|	} 2>&1  | grep 'real' | awk '{print $$2}' | python3 'bench/stats.py'
192|
193|newbench:
194|	for f in $(BENCHSAMPLES) ; do \
195|	  printf "%26s  " `basename $$f` ; \
196|	  { for x in `seq 1 $(NUMRUNS)` ; do \
197|		/usr/bin/env time -p $(PROG) </dev/null >/dev/null ; \
198|		for x in `seq 1 200` ; do cat $$f ; done | \
199|		  /usr/bin/env time -p $(PROG) > /dev/null; \
200|		done \
201|	  } 2>&1  | grep 'real' | awk '{print $$2}' | \
202|	    python3 'bench/stats.py'; done
203|
204|format:
205|	$(CLANG_FORMAT) src/*.c src/*.h api_test/*.c api_test/*.h
206|
207|operf: $(CMARK)
208|	operf $< < $(BENCHFILE) > /dev/null
209|
210|distclean: clean
211|	-rm -rf *.dSYM
212|	-rm -f README.html
213|	-rm -rf $(BENCHFILE) $(ALLTESTS) progit
